verdict.rationale: Gitea is documented as a self-hosted Git service, and a community user deployed it as a Git server for a team, which implies standard Git clients can clone, pull and push. The evidence never names the transport protocols or the client workflow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of clone/pull/push over HTTPS, explicit documentation of SSH Git access, confirmation of compatibility with standard Git clients, hands-on corroboration of push/pull workflows

support.subject: As a developer, I can clone, pull, and push repositories with any standard Git client over HTTPS or SSH

citations.quote: Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license.
This makes it convenient for individual developers or small teams to set up and manage their own Git services.
Sysadmin deployed Gitea as a Git server for a small project with 8 users.
Git Large File Storage will be available if enabled and if your Git version is >= 2.1.2
